title: Hog Saga
tagline: A tiny RPG about shipping, by PostHog

text.win: The monolith is unplugged. Peace returns to the land, and the dashboards are green again.
text.lose: The party wiped. Rest at the inn, grab a coffee and try the quest again.
text.credits: Made with PostHog. Music and art generated locally.

game.intro: Bugs have overrun the land. Rumour says the Legacy Monolith is behind it all.

town.name: Shipville
town.inn_line: Rough sprint? Rest here, the coffee is free.

regions.name: Staging Meadows
regions.blurb: Grass, flowers and the odd flaky test.

regions.name: Backlog Woods
regions.blurb: Tickets pile up like leaves. Watch your step.

regions.name: Prod Desert
regions.blurb: Hot, dry and everything is on fire.

party.name: Ada
party.sprite_prompt: a friendly data analyst with glasses and a purple hoodie

party.name: Sam
party.sprite_prompt: a cheerful support lead with a headset and a green shirt

npcs.name: Old Dev
npcs.line: Back in my day we deployed on Fridays. Never again.
npcs.sprite_prompt: an old developer with a grey beard and a mug

npcs.name: PM Pat
npcs.line: The roadmap says we win. The data says... nobody checked the data.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a product manager holding a clipboard

npcs.name: Intern
npcs.line: I found a bug! Wait, it found me. There are more in the woods.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a young intern with a backpack and a laptop

enemies.name: Flaky Test

enemies.name: Silent Error

enemies.name: Scope Creep

enemies.name: Tech Debt

enemies.name: Dashboard Fog

boss.name: Legacy Monolith
boss.taunt: I have been in production since 2009!
boss.phase2: You cannot refactor ME! Deploying on a Friday!
boss.sprite_prompt: a giant crowned mainframe computer monster with glowing eyes
